results.title: New $7M senior center opens to fanfare; regular use won't start until Oct. 19
results.description: Years of effort by city and county officials and members of the Senior Community Center of Owensboro-Daviess County culminated Thursday when leaders from the agencies cut the ribbon and opened the new senior center facility to visitors.

results.title: Tax raid finds Rs 4.34 lakh forex; man wins ITAT case with sister-in-law’s help
results.description: During the operation, officials discovered Rs 1.12 crore in Indian currency and foreign currency worth Rs 4.34 lakh. The man was subsequently taken in for questioning by the tax authorities. Despite the investigation team's acceptance of the explanation, the AO treated both the Indian cash and foreign currency recovered during the search as unexplained money under Section 69A.

results.title: U.S., South Korea: Trump Unveils Investment Deal, Seoul Disputes Its Terms
